_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to your repository root and replace every REPLACE_ME value. A sweep that finds REPLACE_ME still in sentinel_paths stops and asks the owner — an unfilled sentinel list silently disables the Engine 2 trigger.

sentinel_paths._comment: Touching any of these in a diff makes Engine 2 mandatory. These are the places where 'what needs what' is declared: stage definitions, artifact requirements, routes, required fields. Ask: if I changed this file, could a stage start requiring something new, or stop requiring something? Keep the list short — forty paths means Engine 2 runs every time, which is the same as having no rule. See references/config.md.

fanout._comment: max_reviewers is a ceiling, not a quota: a charter with no territory in this slice is not dispatched, because it returns invention rather than nothing. min_reviewers is the floor below which the residual estimate stops meaning anything. second_echelon_trigger: findings from distinct reviewers pointing at one subsystem before reinforcing it. Cost scales with all of these — see the budget section in references/engine-1-fanout.md.

engine_2._comment: combinatorial_tool: 'builtin' uses scripts/covering_array.py, which ships with the skill and needs nothing installed. 'pict' and 'acts' are external and must be on PATH. default_strength 2 = pairwise; escalate to 3 for dimensions where pairwise found a dead end.

stopping._comment: Gate 2. Stop when the residual estimate stays below residual_threshold for consecutive_sweeps_below sweeps in a row. Gate 1 — every class closed by an enumerating guard — has no config, because it is not negotiable.

_test_command_comment: Run at the short-verification step after fixes, not during the sweep. The sweep never edits code, so it never needs to run tests.
_state_file_comment: Registry of closed classes, discarded findings, and the two counters. Must be committed — it is what stops the next sweep re-litigating decisions the owner already made. Required sections and format: references/config.md.
